Simisage

Grass

Unova · Generation 5

Simisage is a Grass-type Thorn Monkey Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 1.1 m tall and weighs 30.5 kg. It evolves from Pansage. Its highest base stat is Speed (101), with a base stat total of 498.
